newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 10 as fixing continues active.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 10 as fixing continues active.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was up 10 at 1,475 points on Friday.

The Equator Explorer 69,149 dwt had been fixed delivery USGulf early April for trip Far East at $16,000 plus bonus and Safmarine were reported to have fixed Sapphire 68,600 dwt delivery Santos end March trip Far East at $11,500 daily plus $460,000 bonus.
But the heaviest volume of fixing continued to be in the Pacific, especially short period timecharter. Rates varied between $10,000 and $13,000 daily depending on type and delivery position.
Handy size rates in the Plate were firmer. Caper rates contineud to advance in the Pacific but the Atlantic, by comparison was flat.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was eight points lower to five points higher and turnover totalled 50 lots.
